commandPolicyMapping.policy: command and sequence branches pass explicit synthesized gesture policy kinds; sequence contexts are resolved once when any synthesized tap or drag step is present

axFreeSynthesis.policy: resolves AX health, screenshot frame, keyboard policy, and fallback policy once per command/step

frameSourcePolicy.policy: screenshot size only; synthesized command contexts do not use app.frame, windows, accessibility frames, or native screen bounds

activationPreflightPolicy.policy: only coordinate-only synthesized tap may skip activation preflight; scroll/drag/sequence keep normal activation

paths.activationPreflightPolicy: coordinate-only synthesized tap may skip activation preflight
